purpose: Canonicalize pilot-specific wording to the pre-frozen common vocabulary without adding a new failure coordinate.

rationale.AUTHORITY_OR_VALIDATION_REPAIR: The common response enum stores the concrete redesign/validation action; authority repair remains available as a successor-transition value.
rationale.NARROW_CLAIM_OR_DOMAIN: A narrowed formal/scientific target is represented as a method/parameter-level successor rather than a new schema coordinate.
rationale.OPEN_SUCCESSOR_SEARCH: An open search does not yet identify the successor transition and is therefore fail-closed to CANNOT_INFER.
rationale.REDESIGN_INTERFACE_OR_SYSTEM: A system redesign is represented at the successor layer as a model/architecture expansion.

reopen_rule: Any pilot value that cannot map to an existing FailureAtlasSchema.v1 coordinate without loss of the registered scientific distinction is a material schema change and resets saturation.
